subject: Compact pilot — Redwood evaluation window & terms
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@novapulse.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Compact pilot — Redwood evaluation window & terms

Hi Samir,

Thanks again for taking the demo last week — really enjoyed walking through the latency profiles you care about. Per our conversation, attached is a compact pilot offer that maps to the 30-day timebox we talked about. Key points summarized below so it's easy to share with procurement: 

- Duration: 30 calendar days (starts on activation)
- Included throughput: up to 100k generation tokens (prefix + completion)
- Price options: flat pilot fee of $12,000 OR pay-as-you-go at $0.012/token up to cap with automatic stop at cap
- Extension/top-up: can add 2-week top-ups in 50k token increments at a discounted rate if added before pilot end
- Security: SOC2 and basic network controls attached (security-sla-summary.pdf)

I attached the formal offer (redwood-compact-poc-offer.pdf). Two quick asks so I can lock the paperwork:
1) Which pricing option do you want (flat fee vs PAYG)?
2) Are you asking for an extension now or would you prefer wait-and-top-up based on burn?

If procurement needs a straightforward path, we have a short MSA + SOW DocuSign route that lets us start the pilot same day. If helpful I can provision an extra week gratis as a one-time concession while you run the security review — let me know.

Best,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0149

Attachment: redwood-compact-poc-offer.pdf (pdf)

From: Samir Patel <samir@novapulse.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Compact pilot — Redwood evaluation window & terms

Sofia — thanks, and appreciate the clear breakdown. A few constraints from our side: 

- Procurement wants fewer billing line items and prefers a small flat fee or a single top-up rather than hourly/per-token complexity.
- Our security team is still finishing the questionnaire; that will take ~10 business days.
- Can you do a 30% pilot discount on the flat fee if we sign this week? If not, would you consider a 1x token top-up at 50k tokens for a reduced rate (we'd likely use the top-up immediately if approved).

If you can provide a one-week runway extension and a top-up option packaged together it would make approval much easier. We can commit to a procurement decision within 45 days but need the pilot to survive the security gating.

Appreciate any flexibility you can offer — happy to jump on a quick call today to close.

—Samir
Samir Patel
Head of AI, NovaPulse
samir@novapulse.ai | +1 312-555-0191

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 08:20:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Compact pilot — pricing/extension ask (NovaPulse)

Marissa / Ben — forwarding Samir's note. He asked for: 30% off flat fee OR a reduced-rate 50k token top-up + one-week runway extension while security completes the questionnaire (~10 business days). Procurement prefers a single-line flat fee.

My read: we should avoid a 30% unilateral discount unless we tie to a conversion commitment. Proposed options to present to customer (pick one):

A) Pilot credit: Keep flat fee at $12k, provide a one-time 25% credit ($3k) that can be applied to a post-pilot committed purchase if they sign an MSA and committed purchase order within 45 days. Also add one-week runway.

B) Token top-up: Offer a 50k token top-up at $0.009/token (25% off the listed PAYG) and include one-week runway free. No MSA commitment required.

C) Single-line adjusted flat fee: reduce flat pilot fee to $9,500 (about 21% off) if they execute the MSA within 10 business days and commit to a 12-month reserved capacity evaluation with a minimal $20k conversion commitment.

Preference: A or B to keep the path to conversion flexible. Thoughts on margin impact? Also confirm legal OK with the 45-day conversion window for credits.

Sofia
cc: Samir (incoming reply will go to him)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@novapulse.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 15:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Compact pilot — Redwood evaluation window & terms

Samir — thanks for the quick turnaround. We discussed internally and can do the following compromise to help procurement and keep the path to a production trial clean: 

Final offer (one-time concession):
- One-week runway extension at no additional charge (pilot will be 37 days total once activated)
- 25% one-time credit on the flat pilot fee (applied as a credit against future committed purchase) — if you choose the flat fee path, that reduces the out-of-pocket to $9,000 (from $12,000)
- Alternatively, if you prefer PAYG, we will make a single 50k token top-up available at $0.009/token (25% off listed PAYG) and include the one-week runway with that top-up.

Conditions:
- The 25% credit requires a signed MSA within 45 days of pilot activation to be applied to a future committed purchase; if no MSA is signed the credit expires.
- Top-up pricing is valid for the initial pilot only and must be added before the pilot end date.

Next steps: I can send an updated offer and a short DocuSign MSA addendum that includes the 45-day credit clause. If you'd like, we can also move the security questionnaire to our secure folder (link below) to speed review.

DocuSign-ready offer: https://redwood.docusign.com/NP-compact-offer
Security folder: https://drive.redwood.com/NP/poc-plan

If that works, reply "Approve" and I'll fire the updated SOW over. Happy to hop on a 20-minute call to walk procurement through the single-line option if that helps.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0149
